The SSC Stenographer Result 2026 has been released by the Staff Selection Commission on 18th June 2026 for the Stenographer Grade C and Grade D Examination 2025. Candidates can check their results on the official website at ssc.gov.in. A total of 4,907 candidates appeared in the Grade C Skill Test, while 12,564 candidates appeared in the Grade D Skill Test. SSC has also announced the First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA), vacancy details & the schedule for the sliding process. Read this article to get more details on SSC Stenographer final result, cut off, sliding process and more.

SSC Stenographer Result 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in

The SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026 is now available on the official SSC website. SSC has completed the FRTA based on candidates merit and department preferences. Earlier, 8,624 candidates qualified for the Grade C Skill Test and 22,456 candidates qualified for the Grade D Skill Test. Out of these, 4,907 candidates appeared for the Grade C Skill Test and 12,564 candidates appeared for the Grade D Skill Test. Candidates who are eligible for the sliding process can select their preferred venue, date & time slot from 19th June 2026 and 22nd June 2026. This step is mandatory for participation in the SSC Stenographer Sliding Process 2026.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026 Overview

The SSC Stenographer 2026 Result is declared for 1715 posts on June 18, 2026. The result comprises the first round of department allocation for Grade C and Grade D posts. Candidates can check important SSC Stenographer final result information from the table below.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026
Exam Name SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Examination 2025
Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
Result Name SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026
Vacancy 1715
SSC Steno Result Status Released
SSC Steno Final Result Date 18th June 2026
Minimum Qualifying Marks
  • UR: 30%
  • OBC/EWS: 25%
  • All Other Categories: 20%
Official Website ssc.gov.in

SSC Stenographer Result 2026 Download Link

The SSC Stenographer result 2026 download link is active now and has been shared below. You can also go to official SSC site to check your result status. Candidates who gave the exam can download the result PDF and check their roll number. The SSC Stenographer final result PDF has the roll numbers and details of shortlisted candidates. Make sure to save a copy of the result for future use.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026: Click Here to Download

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026: Important Dates

SSC has announced important dates related to the sliding process. Candidates should properly check their result and follow all further instructions given by the commission.

Event Date
Online Option-cum-Preference Submission 5th May to 8th May 
SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026 Release 18th June 2026
Venue/Date/Slot Selection for Sliding Process 19th June 2026 to 22th June 2026
Physical Sliding Process 1st July 2026 to 2nd July 2026

How to Check SSC Stenographer Result 2026?

Candidates can see the SSC Stenographer 2026 result online by going to ssc.gov.in. Follow the steps given below to download the result PDF and find your roll number.

  1. Visit the official SSC website.
  2. Click on the “Results” section.
  3. Open the SSC Stenographer Result 2026 link.
  4. Download the SSC Stenographer final result PDF.
  5. Press Ctrl + F on your keyboard.
  6. Enter your Roll Number.
  7. Check your qualifying status.
  8. Save the PDF for future use.

SSC Stenographer Grade C Result 2026

SSC has recommended 228 candidates against 232 vacancies for Grade C posts under the First Round of Tentative Allocation. Some vacancies remained unfilled because eligible candidates were not available in certain categories.

SSC Stenographer Cut Off 2026

The SSC Stenographer Cut Off has also been released with the final result. It is the minimum score needed to qualify for the next stage of the selection process. The marks of the last selected candidates for different posts and categories have been published along with the SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026.

Grade C (C3) OBC 156.85

Grade C (C3) EWS 158.97

SSC Stenographer Skill Test Qualifying Criteria

Candidates had to stay within the maximum error limit stated by SSC in the Skill Test to be considered for selection. The allowed error percentage was different for Grade C and Grade D posts.

Post Category Maximum Errors Allowed
Grade C UR Up to 5%
Grade C Reserved Categories Up to 7%
Grade D UR Up to 7%
Grade D Reserved Categories Up to 10%

SSC Stenographer Sliding Process 2026

SSC has introduced a Sliding Mechanism to fill as many vacancies as possible. Through this process, candidates may get a higher preferred department if vacancies become available. Candidates need to attend the process physically, otherwise they will not be considered for the final allocation.

Event Date
Choice of Venue, Date and Slot 19 June 2026 to 22 June 2026
Physical Sliding Process 1 July 2026 to 2 July 2026
Mode Physical Attendance Required
Purpose Reallocation to Higher Preferred Departments

What are SSC Stenographer Tie-Breaking Rules?

If two or more candidates get the same marks, SSC uses the following tie-breaking rules:

  • Higher marks in English Language & Comprehension.
  • Higher marks in General Awareness.
  • Older candidate gets preference.
  • Alphabetical order of names.

What Happens After SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026?

Shortlisted candidates have to participate in the sliding process if they wish to be considered for better department allocation after the SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026. Once the sliding process is completed, SSC will prepare the final allocation list. After the final result is declared, the commission will upload the marks of both selected and non-selected candidates on its official website.

SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is SSC Stenographer Result 2026 released?

Yes, the SSC Stenographer Result 2026 is out on 18th June.

Q2. What is SSC Stenographer Final Result 2026?

It is the result containing the FRTA for Grade C and Grade D posts.

Q3. How can I check SSC Stenographer 2026 Result?

You can check the result by downloading the PDF from the SSC website and looking for your roll number.

Q4. How many candidates were recommended for Grade C posts?

A total of 228 candidates were recommended against 232 vacancies.

Q5. How many candidates were recommended for Grade D posts?

A total of 1,483 candidates were recommended against 1,483 vacancies.

Q6. What is the SSC Stenographer Sliding Process?

SSC Steno sliding process is a special process that allows candidates to be  considered for higher departments of choice, in case there are more vacancies.

Q7. Is attendance mandatory for the sliding process?

Yes, candidates need to attend the SSC Stenographer sliding process physically. Absent candidates will not be considered further.

Q8. When will the SSC Steno sliding process be conducted?

The physical sliding process will be held on 1st July 2026 and 2nd July 2026.
